title: Platform Expansion Through Asset Provision: Ownership, Commitment, and Flexibility

abstract: We document key features of trade allowances—a major component of the contracts between large retailers and manufacturers—using a unique panel data set on allowance payments negotiated between two supermarket chains owned by a large retailer and its suppliers over a two-year period. We show that trade allowances are large in magnitude, are paid by the vast majority of suppliers, and vary substantially over categories and, especially, across suppliers within categories. We further study trade allowance behavior along key dimensions of the manufacturer–retailer relationship. First, we report important interdependencies between allowances paid by multicategory suppliers across different categories, suggesting that single-category analysis of manufacturer–retailer interactions may be misleading. Second, we show that dedicated private label manufacturers do pay allowances, and that dual branders (i.e., national brand manufacturers who in addition produce private labels) tend to pay lower allowances than fully national brand manufacturers. Third, we examine the relationship between allowance payments and price promotional activities and find that price and nonprice incentives tend to be treated as substitutes. Fourth, we document a positive relationship between allowance payments and prices, suggesting that trade allowances do not mitigate the double marginalization problem. Finally, the evidence suggests that both market power and efficiency aspects are at play in the explanation of trade allowances. This paper was accepted by Eric Anderson, marketing. Funding: This work was supported by the Institute for Research in Market Imperfections and Public Policy [Grant ICM IS130002] and Fondo Nacional de Desarrollo Científico y Tecnológico [Initiation Grant 11180301 and Regular Grant 1170029]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.00817 .
abstract_zh: 我们利用一个独特的面板数据集，记录了贸易折让——大型零售商与制造商之间合同的主要组成部分——的关键特征，该数据集涵盖了一家大型零售商旗下两家连锁超市与其供应商在两年期间协商的折让支付。我们发现，贸易折让规模巨大，绝大多数供应商都会支付，并且在不同品类之间，尤其是同一品类内不同供应商之间存在显著差异。我们进一步从制造商—零售商关系的关键维度研究贸易折让行为。首先，我们报告了多品类供应商在不同品类之间所支付折让的重要相互依赖性，这表明仅对制造商—零售商互动进行单一品类分析可能具有误导性。其次，我们表明，专门的自有品牌制造商确实会支付折让，而双重品牌商（即同时生产自有品牌的全国性品牌制造商）往往比纯粹的全国性品牌制造商支付更低的折让。第三，我们考察折让支付与价格促销活动之间的关系，发现价格激励与非价格激励往往被视为替代品。第四，我们记录了折让支付与价格之间的正向关系，表明贸易折让并未缓解双重边际化问题。最后，证据表明，市场力量与效率因素都在解释贸易折让时发挥作用。本文由市场营销领域的Eric Anderson接受。资助：本研究得到市场不完美与公共政策研究所[Grant ICM IS130002]以及国家科学技术发展基金[Initiation Grant 11180301 and Regular Grant 1170029]的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.00817获取。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: What Do Trade Allowances Look Like? Evidence from Actual Payments to a Big-Box Retailer
title_zh: 贸易补贴是什么样子？来自一家大型零售商实际支付的证据

abstract: We identify a new channel in the monetary policy transmission to nonfinancial corporates—the zombie lending channel. Our findings show that unviable and unproductive zombie firms are less affected by contractionary monetary policy relative to other firms because of a more muted tightening in credit conditions. We rationalize this result with a strengthening in evergreening motives when interest rates rise: lenders face incentives to extend loans to zombies to prevent them from defaulting. Strengthening banks’ balance sheets and curbing risky lending behavior could help mitigate zombie lending practices when financial conditions tighten. This paper was accepted by Tomasz Piskorski, finance. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07315 .
abstract_zh: 我们识别出货币政策向非金融企业传导的一条新渠道——僵尸贷款渠道。我们的研究结果表明，与其他企业相比，无法存续且生产效率低下的僵尸企业受紧缩性货币政策的影响较小，原因是其信贷条件的收紧更为温和。我们通过利率上升时“常青贷款”动机的增强来解释这一结果：贷款方面临向僵尸企业展期贷款的激励，以防止其违约。强化银行资产负债表并遏制高风险放贷行为，可能有助于在金融条件收紧时减轻僵尸贷款行为。本文由金融学领域编辑Tomasz Piskorski接收。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2024.07315获取。
publisher: Institute for Operations Research and the Management Sciences (INFORMS)
title: The Zombie Lending Channel of Monetary Policy
title_zh: 货币政策的僵尸贷款渠道

abstract: It is well-known that the detection of change-points in heavy-tailed time series is an open problem since the traditional tests may not have a power. This article introduces a winsorized cumulative sum (CUSUM) approach to solve this problem. We begin by investigating the winsorized CUSUM process and then use it to construct the Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) test and the Self-normalized (SN) test. Under the null hypothesis, it is shown that each weakly converges to the maximum of a function related to the standard Brownian bridge. Under the alternative, we first study the behavior of tests after applying the winsorization technique, and then show that our tests have a power approaching to 1 as the sample size n→∞. Furthermore, we extend the winsorizing technique to test for multiple change-points without prior knowledge of the number of change points. Our framework is general and its assumptions are mild, so that our tests can be applied to a wide range of linear and nonlinear time series. The empirical results illustrate the effectiveness of our proposed procedures for change-point detection.
abstract_zh: 众所周知，重尾时间序列中的变点检测是一个开放性问题，因为传统检验可能缺乏功效。本文引入了一种截尾累积和（CUSUM）方法来解决这一问题。我们首先研究截尾CUSUM过程，并利用其构建Kolmogorov-Smirnov（KS）检验和自归一化（SN）检验。在原假设下，我们证明每个检验均弱收敛于与标准布朗桥相关的函数的最大值。在备择假设下，我们首先研究应用截尾技术后检验的行为，然后证明随着样本量n→∞，我们的检验功效趋近于1。此外，我们将截尾技术扩展至无需预先知道变点数量的多重变点检验。我们的框架具有一般性，且假设条件宽松，因此我们的检验可广泛应用于线性和非线性时间序列。实证结果展示了我们提出的变点检测程序的有效性。
title: Testing for Change-Points in Heavy-Tailed Time Series—A Winsorized CUSUM Approach
title_zh: 重尾时间序列变点检测——一种Winsorized CUSUM方法

abstract: Abstract What are the macro‐economic consequences of a government that is limited in its willingness or ability to raise primary surpluses, and a central bank that accommodates its interest‐rate policy to the fiscal conditions? I address this question in a dynamic stochastic sticky‐price model with endogenous shifts between an “orthodox” and a “fiscally‐dominant” policy regime. The risk of future regime shifts has encompassing effects on equilibrium. Inflation is systematically higher than it would be if fiscal policy always adjusted its primary surplus sufficiently and monetary policy was solely concerned with price stability. This inflation bias is increasing in the real value of government debt. Regime‐switching probabilities are not invariant to policy. The central bank can attenuate the risk of a shift to the fiscally‐dominant regime by raising the real interest rate sufficiently moderately when inflation increases. Lower fiscal dominance risk, in turn, mitigates the inflation bias.
abstract_zh: 摘要 当政府受限于其提高基本财政盈余的意愿或能力，而中央银行又使其利率政策适应财政状况时，会产生怎样的宏观经济后果？我在一个动态随机粘性价格模型中探讨了这一问题，该模型包含“正统”与“财政主导”政策体制之间的内生转换。未来体制转换的风险对均衡具有广泛影响。通货膨胀系统性高于若财政政策始终充分调整其基本盈余且货币政策仅关注价格稳定时的水平。这种通胀偏差随政府债务实际价值的增加而增大。体制转换概率并非政策不变。中央银行可以通过在通胀上升时适度提高实际利率来减弱向财政主导体制转换的风险。较低的财政主导风险反过来又会缓解通胀偏差。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Monetary–Fiscal Policy Interactions When Price Stability Occasionally Takes a Back Seat
title_zh: 价格稳定偶尔退居次要地位时的货币-财政政策互动
